title: DocPuzzle: A Process-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Realistic Long-Context Reasoning Capabilities

bias_targets.methodology: Implementing a checklist-guided process analysis that evaluates the validity of intermediate reasoning chains alongside final answers, preventing models from receiving inflated scores through random guessing in multiple-choice or true-false formats.

Restricting benchmark questions to objective tasks with deterministic answers and using majority voting across multiple prompt variants to minimize subjectivity, annotation variance, and judge model randomness.
